jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales (scheme covering participating NSW firms and organisations)
jobs.program: Summer Clerkship Recruitment Program - 2027 recruitment round (clerkships over summer 2027/28)
jobs.notes: The Law Society's live clerkship page publishes 2027 recruitment dates and confirms applications for summer clerkships open Wednesday 9 June 2027; eligibility is penultimate year of degree, with some firm-by-firm exceptions, but the exact closing date (historically a July Sunday, with some firms a week later) was not confirmed on the source so it is left null.

The firm's own early careers page states it did not take market applications for the 2026 Hobart program and directs students to watch the page for 2027 program information, so a future round is flagged but no open/close dates are published yet; its Sydney, Adelaide, Brisbane and Darwin windows shown on the same page relate to the 2026 round and have already closed.
